item.title: 5 Prayers for Guidance as You Make Big Decisions
item.description: Typically, seeking godly counsel from the Holy Spirit can help with big choices like moving, witnessing to a neighbor who may not be saved, or making other big life changes. Going to the Lord should be a Christian’s primary source for guidance, complemented by Scripture, and consulting godly brothers and sisters in the faith.

item.title: How to Deepen Our Relationship with God
item.description: Embracing humility is not a surrender of one's identity; rather, it's an acknowledgment that our existence is part of a grander narrative.

item.title: 5 Things We Get When We Give to Others
item.description: What we may not realize is when we give to others, we actually receive something in return. The things that we receive when we give are often more valuable than anything that we could give to yourselves.

item.title: A Prayer for God’s Comfort When Your Family Is Broken - Your Daily Prayer - February 19
item.description: When family relationships break, God’s embrace remains unshaken. Let Him hold you close and restore your heart with His perfect love.
